data: Which line in the right panel (labelled (b) OUR) represents performance on seen classes?

The caption states that the blue line represents performance on seen classes, while the red line represents performance on unseen classes. In the right panel (labeled (b) OUR), the blue line is consistently above the red line throughout the training process, indicating better performance on seen classes compared to unseen classes. Therefore, the blue line in the right panel represents performance on seen classes.
